description: Fixed-point approximation of 128 * log2(x): integer part from the leading-zero count, fraction from the next 7 bits with a parabolic correction (silk_lin2log)
notes: Opus 1.5.2, silk_lin2log (silk/lin2log.c), with silk_CLZ_FRAC (silk/Inlines.h), silk_CLZ32 and silk_ROR32 (silk/macros.h, silk/SigProc_FIX.h) and the 64-bit silk_SMLAWB selected on x86-64 by OPUS_FAST_INT64 (celt/arch.h) inlined. Written by us from the functions. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: ctlz, the rotation by 24 - lz kept as two branches and a phi, then two multiplications, shifts and adds: 25 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
